name: Old Chinese Junk
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A drawing of a large junk in the Pearl River at Canton (Guangzhou), with sails lowered and rudder raised, and small boats alongside; a mythical bird is painted on the ship's stern.
On the back are pencil sketches of vessels and a tree.
